c5d1e7a0-0001-4000-8000-000000000009.body: Hover over a row to see its values, then click it. The last cell shows how much the row changed.

c5d1e7a0-0001-4000-8000-000000000010.body: The recipe draws each row as a bar from before to after, with a dot at each end.

c5d1e7a0-0001-4000-8000-000000000011.body: This method makes each row one mark. It passes the recipe's bars, p.plots[1], so a row responds along its whole drawn width, and gives each row a payload with its values.

c5d1e7a0-0001-4000-8000-000000000012.body: masque(fig) uses the method for the dumbbell! plot, bind = d makes pick the clicked row itself, and @bind pick saves a click in pick.

c5d1e7a0-0001-4000-8000-000000000013.body: pick starts as nothing. After a click, pick.change is the clicked row's change.
